verdict.rationale: mParticle documents IDSync as its identity-resolution framework for building a unified customer view [mparticle-docs-x1], a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization' [mparticle-docs-4], and 'Get a complete view of your users' [mparticle-docs-9], implying a queryable profile store. However, evidence never explicitly names or details a 'Profile API' with schema for traits/identifiers/event-history retrieval, nor shows hands-on usage confirming query capability. Missing for 10: explicit Profile API reference docs with request/response examples covering traits, identifiers, and event history, and independent/hands-on confirmation of querying it.
